connector.name: Matomo Analytics
connector.registryDescription: Curated read-only Matomo Analytics tools: traffic, pages, referrers, e-commerce, real-time & more.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Cargo crate matomo-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the liohtml account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
